title: workflow.json
description: Declarative, stateful SDD pipeline. Every step binds to an instruction file and, optionally, to a specific agent model/effort and background execution.

version.description: Schema version this file conforms to.

type.description: Selects the harness profile under harness/profiles/.

language.description: Output language for ALL agent-authored artifacts AND for the agent's replies in the session (BCP-47-ish code, e.g. en, pt_BR). Agents must not switch languages on their own.

code_naming.description: Identifier language in source code. english = everything in English (findUsers). hybrid = technical vocabulary in English, domain/business terms in project.language (findUsuarios). project-language = everything in project.language (buscarUsuarios). The enforceable rules are materialized in constitution/03-code-standards.md.

comments.description: Code-comment policy. Comments are always written in project.language; these fields set how much and in which format. Materialized as enforceable rules in constitution/03-code-standards.md.

scope.description: minimal = one short comment above each public function/method, nothing inline. detailed = inline comments inside functions/methods are also expected on non-obvious blocks.

reference_docs.description: The language's structured doc format, stack-dependent: javadoc (Java), jsdoc/tsdoc (JS/TS), docstrings (Python), godoc, rustdoc, xmldoc (C#)… Empty = none.

api_docs.description: API contract documentation for service projects: openapi (Swagger), asyncapi, graphql-sdl… Empty = none.

harness.description: Optional Harness Engineering layer. Omit or set enabled:false to run pure SDD with no verify loop.

github.description: Optional GitHub integration. When enabled, pipeline steps drive issues, PRs, comments, commits, README/CHANGELOG and a Projects v2 board. Omit or set enabled:false to run with no GitHub side effects.

workspace.description: Optional multi-project workspace. role:hub lists the satellite projects whose context and repos this pipeline drives; role:satellite delegates ALL pipeline state to the hub (a satellite file needs no steps).

engine.description: The SDD engine driving feature lifecycles and artifact layout. 'default' is bundled; other names resolve to engines/<name>/engine.json (see docs/engines.md). Omitting the block means default.

defaults.description: Inherited by any step that does not override them. Resolution is nearest-ancestor-wins.

render_pipeline_before_response.description: Hard requirement: the agent renders the pipeline state before every answer in the session. Enforced deterministically by the UserPromptSubmit hook in .claude/settings.json.

strict_gates.description: A step cannot start while any step in `requires` is not done, or while its predecessor's gate is unsatisfied.

single_in_progress.description: At most one foreground step may be in_progress at a time. Background steps are exempt.

escalate_on_constitution_violation.description: On conflict with constitution/, stop and escalate rather than silently adjusting.

auto_append_features.description: Every new SDD feature is appended as a step under the container step flagged container_for:"features".

ask_agent_review.description: When true, adding a feature to the pipeline offers a card to review that feature's per-step agents. Set false to skip the question and keep the defaults silently (adjust anytime via /wf-agents).

model.description: haiku = cheap/fast mechanical work; sonnet = balanced default; opus = deep reasoning, architecture, adversarial review; fable = long-horizon synthesis and drafting.

effort.description: Reasoning budget for the step. Raise it for ambiguity and irreversibility, not for volume.

subagent_type.description: Optional named sub-agent to delegate this step to (e.g. Explore, Plan, general-purpose).

isolation.description: worktree gives the step its own git worktree — use for steps that write code in parallel.

gate.description: What must be true before the NEXT step may start. human_approval blocks on an explicit human yes.

profile.description: Path to the harness profile doc, e.g. harness/profiles/api.md.

verify.description: The single green/red command agents and CI both call, e.g. "make verify".

ci.description: Path to the CI workflow that runs verify on every PR.

signals.description: Ordered checks composing verify, e.g. ["lint", "typecheck", "test", "build"]. Each becomes a separate step in the generated CI workflow.

commands.description: Per-signal shell command, e.g. {"test": "npm test", "build": "npm run build"}. Used by `wf harness ci` to generate the workflow. A signal with no command generates a step that fails until wired.

repo.description: Target repository as owner/name (a full https URL is normalized to this by `wf github on`).

default_branch.description: The repo's protected trunk. Feature work NEVER targets it directly; it receives promotion PRs from the integration branch (/wf-promote).

integration_branch.description: Where feature PRs land (the review step's PR base). Set equal to default_branch for trunk-based flow. Promotion to the trunk goes integration → default via /wf-promote.

assignee.description: GitHub username assigned to issues opened for features, and pinged in comments.

reviewers.description: Usernames requested as reviewers on the feature PRs. GitHub refuses the PR's own author as reviewer — when that happens the request is skipped with a note and the 👍+approve protocol still applies.

labels.description: Base labels applied to every issue/PR, on top of the contextual ones the payloads add (feature, us-X.Y, the routed project, promotion).

milestone.description: Current milestone name; applied to issues and PRs while set. Update per release cycle.

commit_convention.description: conventional = Conventional Commits (feat/fix/docs...) generated per task.

project.description: GitHub Projects v2 board synced with step status.

owner.description: Project owner (org or user); defaults to the repo owner.

role.description: hub = this project owns the pipeline, SDD docs and state; satellite = this project delegates all of that to the hub and keeps only code + local memory/handoff.

hub.description: satellite only: path to the hub project, relative to this file (e.g. ../users-api).

projects.description: hub only: the satellite projects. Their sources compose the hub's context; their repos receive the commits/issues/PRs of features routed to them.

path.description: Relative to the hub root, e.g. ../users-web.

repo.description: owner/name — where this satellite's commits, issues and PRs go.

stack.description: The satellite's tech stack, e.g. ["react", "next"]. Plans for features routed here design against it; mirrored in the satellite's own workflow.json.

github_link.description: State recorded by `wf github link`: which GitHub objects a feature maps to.

merged.description: How far this feature has landed: its integration-branch merge (develop) or full promotion (main). `wf github pending` reports every feature stuck at develop.

id.description: Stable, immutable, unique across the whole file. Never reuse an id.

kind.description: container = holds dynamically appended children (e.g. features); feature = one SDD feature.

instructions.description: REQUIRED. Markdown instruction file for this step, named instructions/<name>-<otherinfo>.md. This is the step's prompt — the agent reads it before acting.

background.description: true = dispatch as a background sub-agent; the pipeline continues without blocking. Only safe for steps that neither hold a gate nor write files another running step writes.

command.description: Optional slash command that drives this step, e.g. /wf-run spec.

requires.description: Step ids that must be `done` first. Enables a DAG, not just a line.

produces.description: Artifact paths/globs this step must leave behind. Used to detect a step claimed done but with nothing to show.

acceptance.description: Checklist that must hold before status may become done.

commit_type.description: Conventional Commits type for this step's commit (feat, fix, docs, test, refactor, chore). Defaults to feat for feature tasks.

project.description: Workspace routing: the workspace.projects name whose codebase (and repo) this feature targets. Commits/issues/PRs for it go to that satellite's repo.

delegate.description: External-engine stage: the .claude/commands/<delegate>.md flow this step runs (via instructions/engine-delegate.md). Written by `wf feature add` from the engine manifest.

github.description: GitHub objects this step (typically a feature) maps to. Written by `wf github link`.

container_for.description: Marks this step as the insertion point for dynamically created steps.

steps.description: Recursive substeps. Nesting is unbounded: a step's substeps may have their own substeps. A parent is `done` only when every child is done or skipped.
